_about: Taichi Yuhino (141171, psychic_taichi): a laid-back 41-year-old drifter from post-disappearance Japan. Translated from the game's Japanese. Global names/terms: Taichi Yuhino, Marina (he calls her by her surname, Mamiya), Lean Pirate (Eiji) / Burly Pirate (Beads), the Crimson Blades, Suizen, Inaho, Amelia, Nao Nagihara, Gerard, Shou, Nimbus, Light, Stella, Alk, Vagner, Schult, Armadeus, Yamato, Hakunroh, the East/the West, Shibuya Curry House, the Star Augurs. Own: the Land of Wa (ワの国), Osei, Yukko, Nami(no), Akemi, Demon God's Hand: Resonance (skill, as in units.json).
profile: Taichi Yuhino. Age 41. A man who chased an illusion into the vast void that stole his friends and family, and could never return. Wandering from place to place, he turned away from his wishes and hopes. But now, before his eyes, "everything" is starting to reveal itself.
titleCondition: Level Taichi Yuhino to 100 and obtain his Amity Scroll

1.title: The Drifter
1.summary: While exterminating yokai from the West that attack people in the Land of Wa, Alk and the others meet Taichi Yuhino, a friend of Marina's. Taichi, who knows the chaos Japan fell into after Shibuya vanished, is shown the Shibuya that should have disappeared, and celebrates his reunion with Marina all over again.

2.title: Can't Be Helped
2.summary: After telling Marina how her friends and family fared after Shibuya vanished, Taichi decides to have a drink for the first time in a while. That night, he dreams for the first time in years of the day he was swallowed by the void, and through a late-night talk with Alk in the dining hall, he decides to visit his hometown, Shibuya.

3.title: I'm On Your Side
3.summary: Arriving in his hometown of Shibuya, Taichi is reunited, thanks to Alk, with his father, who runs the best curry shop in the world. Declaring he'll spend half of the rest of his life on Alk to repay even a little of that debt, Taichi ends up fighting over Alk with a jealous Marina, who feels like Alk has been stolen from her.

5000471/3.19:
Taichi Yuhino, a man who drifted from Japan to the Land of Wa, turned out to be the only son of this shop's owner.

Five years passed after the town of Shibuya vanished from Japan. Those left behind accepted it in many ways: some as death, some unable to accept it, and some truly believing their loved ones were alive somewhere. For Taichi, who drifted for fifteen more years, it was an unexpected reunion twenty years in the making.

Meanwhile, for the master, it was a middle-aged man suddenly appearing and claiming to be his son, but his crying face was apparently more than enough to convince him it was his boy.

5000639/1.19:
The phenomenon of fragments of the West merging into the East has continued intermittently since then, and the increase in yokai from the West, as well as the disappearance and reappearance of Hakunroh, the pleasure quarter of the East, can be seen as part of it.

Meanwhile, the West itself still has not been found, even now that all seven domains have been gathered. Suizen apparently suspects it may have been "knocked away" during the first merging.

The West, vanished into the gap or some distant world, may someday fully merge with the East, so it seems there will be no end to the diviners' worries.
